lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in semi-regular vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank, creating a grid-like spatial distribution of local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, forming a lattice where the blobs serve as anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A commensal remora is visible attached to the ventral surface posterior to the pectoral fin; the pectoral fin itself displays a significantly higher density of smaller high-luminance spots compared to the lateral flank.
